script:
t1 = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=10553811442"
t2 = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=16421775678"
t3 = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=201503111"

local p = game.Players:GetChildren()
local w = game.Workspace:GetChildren()

for i,v in pairs(p) do
pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter", v.Character.Torso)
pe.Texture = t3
pe.VelocitySpread = 100
end

for i= 1,#w do
if w[i]:isA("BasePart") then
pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter", w[i])
pe.Texture = t3
pe.VelocitySpread = 5
end
end
